description: Reads a local .md or .txt file and returns both the full readability analysis and the list of detected barrier issues. Markdown files are analyzed as prose only (code blocks, tables, badges and URLs are ignored).

ignoreWords.description: Optional case-insensitive list of domain/product words or acronyms to ignore when flagging complex words and undefined acronyms (team glossary).

lang.description: Analysis language code: "en" (English, Flesch Reading Ease) or "es" (Spanish, Fernández-Huerta). Defaults to "en".

path.description: Path to a local .md or .txt file to analyze for readability metrics and barriers.

name: check_file
title: Check Markdown or Text File Readability
